beats.label: Ciao. This is Liam, in for Bear. Ask Claude Code to build a new feature, and it may start coding str
Slash feature dev: the plugin's one command. An agent: a helper Claude sends off on one job, which r
Type slash feature dev, then the feature in plain words. The command walks it through seven phases,
Phase one, discovery. If the request is unclear, Claude asks what problem it solves, what it should
Phase two, exploration. Two or three code explorer agents go out in parallel, each tracing a differe
Phase three, clarifying questions. The command calls it critical: do not skip. Claude lists every ga
Phase four, architecture. Two or three code architect agents each draw one blueprint: minimal change
Phase five, the build, and it doesn't start until you approve. Claude follows the blueprint you chos
Phase six, quality review. Three code reviewer agents check the new code in parallel: for simplicity
Phase seven, the summary. Claude marks every to-do done, then writes up what was built, the key deci
The plugin's read me says it's for features that touch several files or need an architecture decisio
Your turn. Install the feature dev plugin, open Claude Code in a repo you know, and paste this: Slas
